{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq for each patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check that we now have one row per patient
print("After deduplication: number of unique patient_id:", data_dedup['patient_id'].nunique())
print("After deduplication: total rows:", len(data_dedup))

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = data_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(data_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

print(f"Number of patients with severe baseline disease: {severe_count}")
print(f"Total number of patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")

# Return the fraction
fraction_severe"}
